theorem eventually_original_boundedPolylog_four_payments
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hg2 : MemLp g 2 μ)
    (hgmean : (∫ o : Ω, g o ∂μ) = 0)
    (hgsecond : (∫ o : Ω, (g o) ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ) = 1)
    (C a t0 M : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (ht0 : 0 < t0) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      ∀ (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (w : Ω → ℝ),
      Measurable (Function.uncurry r) →
      Integrable (Function.uncurry r) (μ.prod μ) →
      (∀ᵐ a ∂μ, (∫ b : Ω, r a b ∂μ) = 0) →
      (∀ᵐ b ∂μ, (∫ a : Ω, r a b ∂μ) = 0) →
      (∀ᵐ o ∂μ, 0 ≤ w o) →
      (∀ᵐ o ∂μ, w o ≤ Shao.OQ5.P51.boundedPolylogHeight C a n) →
      Integrable (fun o : Ω => (w o) ^ (2 : ℕ)) μ →
      (∫ o : Ω, (w o) ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ) ≤ M →
      (∀ᵐ z ∂μ.prod μ, |r z.1 z.2| ≤ w z.1 * w z.2) →
      (∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a) →
      ∀ y : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ≤ y →
      y ≤ Shao.OQ5.P51.remainderWindowScale
        (Shao.OQ6.BoundedProductEnvelopeTails.tailScale M) t0 *
          Real.rpow (n : ℝ) ((1 : ℝ) / 6) →
      (Shao.OQ6.CanonicalDoubleGhostRowMoments.sampleLaw n μ).real
        (Shao.OQ5.P51.projectionGood n g y)ᶜ +
        Shao.OQ5.P51.remainderPayment n
          (Shao.OQ6.CanonicalDoubleGhostRowMoments.sampleLaw n μ) g r y ≤
        Real.exp (-c * (n : ℝ)) +
          (4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(y * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) / (2 : ℝ)) +
          (9 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Shao.OQ5.P51.boundedPolylogMomentOrder t0 n)

theorem eventually_boundedPolylog_remainder_payments
    (C a t0 M : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht0 : 0 < t0) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ {Ω : Type u} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
        (ν : Measure Ω) [hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
        (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (w : Ω → ℝ)
        (hr : Measurable (Function.uncurry r))
        (hr1 : Integrable (Function.uncurry r) (ν.prod ν))
        (hcR : ∀ᵐ a : Ω ∂ν, (∫ b : Ω, r a b ∂ν) = 0)
        (hcL : ∀ᵐ b : Ω ∂ν, (∫ a : Ω, r a b ∂ν) = 0)
        (hW : ∀ᵐ a : Ω ∂ν, 0 ≤ w a)
        (hWR : ∀ᵐ o : Ω ∂ν, w o ≤ boundedPolylogHeight C a n)
        (hSq : Integrable (fun a : Ω => (w a) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ν)
        (hSqBound : (∫ a : Ω, (w a) ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂ν) ≤ M)
        (hEnv : ∀ᵐ z : Ω × Ω ∂ν.prod ν, |r z.1 z.2| ≤ w z.1 * w z.2)
        (hsym : ∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a)
        (y : ℝ) (hy : (1 : ℝ) ≤ y)
        (hyWindow : y ≤ remainderWindowScale (tailScale M) t0 *
          Real.rpow (n : ℝ) (1 / 6 : ℝ)),
        (sampleLaw n ν).real (lowerStudentizerBad n g r y) ≤
            (3 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(boundedPolylogMomentOrder t0 n)) ∧
          (sampleLaw n ν).real (numeratorRemainderBad n g r y) ≤
            (3 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(boundedPolylogMomentOrder t0 n)) ∧
          (sampleLaw n ν).real (denominatorRemainderBad n g r y) ≤
            (3 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(boundedPolylogMomentOrder t0 n)) ∧
          remainderPayment n (sampleLaw n ν) g r y ≤
            (9 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(boundedPolylogMomentOrder t0 n)) ∧
          (sampleLaw n ν).real (remainderBadUnion n g r y) ≤
            (3 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(boundedPolylogMomentOrder t0 n))
